title: Dashboard
description: Top-level container of a dashboard: identifier, title, optional description, optional named shared requests, and the embedded layout of cells on the ui-kit Grid.

id.description: Combined anonymous instance identifier: the dashboard type chain followed by a lowercase UUID, for example gts.frontx.dashboard.dashboard.dashboard.v1~<uuid>. No separate type field exists; the base operand is a literal, never /$id.

description.description: Optional longer description of the dashboard purpose.

requests.description: Optional named shared requests. A shared-form binding names one of these in its source. Each name matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ and maps to a request of the request type. Plain data, not GTS instances.

layout.description: Layout embedded in a Dashboard: an ordered array of cells, placed by the ui-kit Grid in this order. Inlined as the Dashboard layout property; not a GTS type and not independently addressable.

cells.description: Ordered array of layout cells, in reading and keyboard order. May be empty; an empty array renders nothing and shows no placeholder.

flexible.description: Whether spans may move inside each size class's range to fill rows (the ui-kit Grid's flexible mode). Without it, true.

cell.description: Embedded cell within a Layout: its size class and height class on the ui-kit Grid, the widget it renders, and an optional widget for its larger view. Inlined as each item of the layout cells array; not a GTS type and not independently addressable.

size.description: Size class of the cell on the ui-kit Grid. The Grid picks the span from it at the width of the dashboard area.

height.description: Height class of the cell: low is one row track, high is two row tracks and the gap between them. Without it, low.

widget.description: The widget rendered in this cell, embedded inline. It is registered on its own against the widget type that its id names. A data widget carries its own embedded binding in data.

larger_view.description: Optional widget shown in the larger view of this cell, embedded inline and registered on its own. It is a second widget instance with its own id. When it is absent, the cell hides its larger-view button.
